details: VELDO-0149 detail: adopted/two-repositories: the owner's signed activation on the first is accepted; the owner's signed activation on the second is accepted; each is one ACTIVE project of the owner bound to its repository; every field is bound as signed; exactly one record of each
VELDO-0149 detail: adopted/unadopted-refused: control: the same activation on a repository the store binds for this domain is accepted

VELDO-0149 detail: adopted/observed: the accepted activation names its project, repository, the binding that adopted it and its path; the refused one names its path, its refusal and its class, and no binding; the signed-command activations are counted accepted and refused, by refusal

VELDO-0149 detail: answer/activates: the settlement applies one activation; it creates one ACTIVE project of the owner on the store-bound repository; it binds owner, charter, execution repository, authority policy and finite budget as proposed; its record is the signed command's record: the same fields, digest and state; its provenance names the settlement it came from; applying the same settlement again refuses already_exists and writes nothing

VELDO-0149 detail: answer/binds-every-field: the request omitting owner is settled, and refuses missing_field:owner with nothing written; the request omitting charter is settled, and refuses missing_field:charter with nothing written; the request omitting execution_repository is settled, and refuses missing_field:execution_repository with nothing written; the request omitting authority_policy is settled, and refuses missing_field:authority_policy with nothing written; the request omitting coordination_budget is settled, and refuses missing_field:coordination_budget with nothing written

VELDO-0149 detail: answer/unsettled: a presented request nobody answered refuses unsettled:no_answer, nothing written; answered but not yet settled refuses unsettled:not_settled, nothing written; control: once the settlement settles his reply, the same request activates; a settled rejection refuses not_approved:reject, nothing written

VELDO-0149 detail: answer/owner-only: it refuses not_owner: he is not the owner the activation binds, and nothing is written; an answer by one member for a project another would own refuses not_owner, nothing written
VELDO-0149 detail: answer/stale: it refuses stale_answer, nothing written

VELDO-0149 detail: answer/observed: the accepted activation names its request, settlement, receipt, presentation, repository and binding; a missing field, an unsettled answer, another member's answer and a stale answer are distinct classes; the settled-answer activations are counted accepted and refused, by refusal
